tools.name: save_transaction
tools.description: Save a financial transaction to the database with proper validation and fee calculation

merchant.description: Name of the merchant or ATM (e.g., 'Woermann Brock', 'FNB ATM')

amount.description: Transaction amount - negative for expenses, positive for income

bank.description: The bank used for the transaction

account_type.description: Specific account type from banking JSON (e.g., 'FNB_Platinum_Lifestyle_EPO')

tools.name: get_monthly_bundle_usage
tools.description: Get current month's bundle usage for FNB EPO accounts to calculate accurate fees

user_id.description: User ID to check bundle usage for

account_type.description: FNB account type to check bundle for

tools.name: get_monthly_finance_summary
tools.description: Generate monthly finance widget data for display

user_id.description: User ID to generate summary for

year.description: Year for summary (optional, defaults to current)

month.description: Month for summary (optional, defaults to current)
